title: Reverse Substrings Between Each Pair of Parentheses
summary: Given a string consisting of lowercase letters and parentheses, reverse the substrings within each pair of matching parentheses, beginning with the innermost pair.
statement: Given a string consisting of lowercase letters and parentheses, reverse the substrings within each pair of matching parentheses, beginning with the innermost pair. Ensure no parentheses remain in the final output.
constraints: Reverse innermost contents first and omit all parentheses.
hints: Use a stack of text buffers, one per open parenthesis depth.
Letters append to the current buffer; an opening parenthesis starts a new buffer.
On closing, pop, reverse, and append the piece to its parent buffer.
Innermost buffers close first, exactly matching the required reversal order.
editorial: Innermost buffers close first, exactly matching the required reversal order.

tests.explanation: Reversing the enclosed text yields dcba.
Inner love becomes evol, then the outer reversal yields iloveu.
